description: Southeast Beverages demand +25% during July 2026 (2026-W28..W31); known event, plan+actual, to test network absorption and the value of re-planning.
hypothesis: A 25% July beverage surge in the Southeast strains PDC01/RDC02/RDC03 and their CDCs; the prepared arm recovers fill rate and lost sales versus the unprepared arm, at the cost of higher inventory and holding cost.
request_text: What if Southeast beverage demand rises 25% in July?

overrides.rationale: Summer demand surge on Southeast beverages, +25% for the 4 July weeks (2026-W28..W31). Assumptions carried in: magnitude +25% exactly; window = weeks whose Monday falls in July 2026; scope = all 100 beverage SKUs already carried in the Southeast (RDC02, RDC03, CDC03-CDC06; no new distribution); event is anticipated, so MEIO pre-builds (plan) and the Twin realises it (actual).
